wat.h2b: A team that belongs to your business.
wat.lede: EML AI Team is a complete, custom AI team for businesses with a team and work that keeps piling up. Every AI employee has a name, a role and a task, and works in your company's tone.
items: AI employees per department
Marketing, sales and follow-up, planning, admin and customer contact. A few agents per department, each doing one task well.
You steer via Telegram
All agents sit in one Telegram group. You hand out tasks by text or voice message, and you approve what matters.
A Chief of Staff
Sums up what happened and puts the decisions to you: approve or wait. From the Growth package.
A dashboard
What the agents did, your figures, your pipeline and your departments on one screen. From the Growth package.
Connected to your systems
Your customer records, mailbox, calendar, quotes, reviews and accounting. Which connections you get depends on your package.
wat.note: No calling agents: your AI team works with text, not on the phone.

afdelingen.lede: Choose a sector. You see which departments an AI team could have there and what each agent does. We draw up your own agent list in the free analysis.
afdelingen.more: We also have example teams for painters, garages and GP practices. Ask about them in your free demo.

stappen.lede: From a first introduction to a team that works with you every day.
items: Free demo
We show you an AI team from your sector, so you can see how it works.
Free analysis
We map out your processes and propose the right package and list of agents.
Build
Once you agree, we build your AI team: your own Anthropic account, the server, the agents and the connections. We test before we go live.
Go-live and management
Your team gets to work. From then on we keep it live: hosting, maintenance, updates, monitoring and support.

pakketten.foot: All prices exclude VAT. Fixed 12-month contract. You pay for Claude usage directly to Anthropic: it is not part of our price.
pakketten.small: Smaller business? Online Growth starts at €150 a month, cancellable monthly.

items: 12-month contract
Every package has a fixed 12-month contract. EML AI Team is not cancellable monthly.
Setup in two parts
You pay 50% of the setup at the start and 50% at go-live. The monthly fee starts at go-live.
After 12 months
The contract is renewed. That is needed to keep your system live.
What the monthly fee covers
Keeping your system live and working: hosting and server management, maintenance and updates, monitoring, support and fixing problems.
What is not included
Claude usage: you pay that directly to Anthropic, through your own account. Subscriptions to your own tools are also yours to pay.
Want something extra
New agents, connections or improvements are not part of the monthly fee. If you want something extra, we make a proposal with a one-off setup price, or you move to another package.
Your data
Your AI team runs on a dedicated server that we manage. Every contract comes with a data processing agreement.
Prices
All prices exclude VAT. Invoices are payable within 14 days.

items.a: That depends on how much work your agents do. You pay it directly to Anthropic, through your own account, and you keep track of it there yourself. So nothing from us is added on top.

Your AI team runs on a dedicated server that we manage, and usage runs through your own Anthropic account. Every contract comes with a data processing agreement, because the agents work with your company's data. It sets out how we handle your data, as the GDPR requires. We never ask for your payment details at Anthropic.
The contract is renewed. That is needed to keep your system live: the monthly fee covers hosting, maintenance and support.

items.q: What if I want something extra later?
items.a: Then we make a proposal: a one-off setup price for the new agents, connections or improvements, or a different package. The monthly fee keeps your system live; building new things is not included.

items.q: How is this different from AI Consulting?
items.a: With AI Consulting you learn to use AI yourself, with our guidance, and it is cancellable monthly. With EML AI Team we build and manage an AI team for your business. It is not an ongoing programme: we build what is in your package and keep it live.

items.q: Does the AI team answer the phone too?
items.a: No. The agents work with text: messages, emails, documents and your systems. For the phone there is the AI receptionist, an add-on to Online Growth.

items.q: Do I need to be technical?
items.a: No. We build, connect and manage everything. You steer your team via Telegram, with a text or a voice message.

items.q: Who is EML AI Team for?
items.a: For businesses with a team and a budget that want to deploy AI employees, not just an AI assistant. We choose which businesses we work with. In the free analysis we look together at whether it fits.

cta.text: Book a free demo. We show you an AI team from your sector and look together at whether it fits your business.
